title: Estimating Training Data Influence by Tracing Gradient Descent

anchors.paraphrase_zh: TracIn 用训练路径上每次使用训练点时，训练梯度与目标点梯度的学习率加权点积近似目标损失下降。

anchors.quote: We use an evaluation technique that has been used by the previous papers
anchors.paraphrase_zh: 主评估通过人为错标 10% 训练数据，再看 self-influence 排名的前缀能找回多少错标样本。
作者把 checkpoint 数量、位置和高损失下降时段分开比较，显示不同训练阶段包含不同归因信息。

anchors.quote: some human judgment is required to apply TracIn correctly
anchors.paraphrase_zh: 论文明确要求人工选择合理的 checkpoint、层和损失头，并谨慎解释归因结果。

formulas: first-order TracIn(z,z') = sum_{t:z_t=z} eta_t grad loss(w_t,z') dot grad loss(w_t,z)
TracInCP(z,z') = sum_i eta_i grad loss(w_ti,z) dot grad loss(w_ti,z')
positive influence denotes a proponent that reduces target loss; negative influence denotes an opponent
algorithm_steps: Choose a target example or target loss and a set of training checkpoints spanning the optimization path.
At every chosen checkpoint, compute target and training-example gradients for selected layers or a projected gradient representation.
Accumulate learning-rate-weighted gradient dot products across checkpoints to form TracInCP.
Rank proponents, opponents or self-influence values and validate the ranking on a task such as synthetic mislabel recovery.
selection_timing: The exact definition attributes every optimizer use along training; practical TracInCP samples saved checkpoints and therefore depends on which training phases are retained.
refresh_rule: Attribution is recomputed by summing over a specified checkpoint set; checkpoints with high loss reduction can carry more information than equally spaced late checkpoints.

budget.unit: number of checkpoints, scored examples and gradient dimensions used for attribution
budget.denominator: the available training trajectory and training dataset
budget.unique_sample_definition: Each training identity receives a target-specific or self-influence score; the method does not choose a fixed replay cardinality.
budget.repeat_definition: Idealized TracIn sums each actual use of a sample, whereas TracInCP counterfactually evaluates every scored sample at each selected checkpoint.
budget.cumulative_exposure_definition: The original optimizer path determines idealized influence, but the paper does not intervene with or equalize additional replay exposures.
budget.compute_cost: Practical cost scales with examples, selected checkpoints, layers and gradient dimension; last-layer gradients and random projections make CIFAR and ImageNet analyses feasible.

random_baselines: NOT_REPORTED_BY_PAPER: the main mislabel ranking compares TracInCP with influence functions and representer points rather than a same-budget uniform random ranking
100 randomly selected test points are used to evaluate approximation correlations, but this is not a replay control
checkpoint_selection: Checkpoints are analysis inputs, not competing model endpoints: examples include every 30th CIFAR checkpoint, every 30th MNIST checkpoint, six evenly spaced DBPedia checkpoints, and ImageNet epochs 30, 60 and 90.

results.claim: 在 CIFAR-10 合成错标识别中，TracInCP 比影响函数和 representer points 更快找回错标。
results.value: more than 80% of mislabeled data is recovered in the first 20% of the TracIn ranking versus less than 50% for the compared methods

anchor.quote: TracIn recovers more than 80% of the mislabelled data
anchor.paraphrase_zh: 该结果验证的是脏标签识别排序，不等价于把高 TracIn 样本重复训练会改善测试指标。

results.claim: 训练阶段决定归因信息，晚期低梯度 checkpoint 可能比中期高损失下降 checkpoint 更弱。
results.value: one middle checkpoint correlates better with stepwise TracIn than the final checkpoint, and more high-loss-reduction checkpoints improve correlation

anchor.quote: selecting checkpoints with high loss reduction, are more informational
anchor.paraphrase_zh: 这为 Stage1 记录全 epoch 动态和阶段一致性提供依据，也否定只看 epoch-200 的充分性。

ablations: idealized stepwise TracIn versus checkpoint heuristic TracInCP
one, multiple, evenly spaced and high-loss-reduction checkpoints
last-layer versus all-model gradients depending on model size
random projection dimensions for influence estimation
learning-rate weighting versus equal checkpoint weighting
negative_results: The MNIST model sometimes failed to converge and produced noisy influence estimates, requiring lower learning rates and larger batches.
A final checkpoint alone correlated less with stepwise influence than a middle checkpoint because late gradients were small.
Misclassified training examples have large gradients and dominate proponent or opponent lists without being discriminative, so the authors filtered them in qualitative applications.
Checkpoint-based attribution discards the exact sample visitation order and is a heuristic counterfactual rather than the exact realized path.
failure_conditions: Checkpoint placement misses the phases with substantial target-loss reduction.
The selected loss head or layer does not represent the deployment objective.
Gradient noise is large relative to the one-example effect, especially under non-convergence or small batches.
Large self-influence identifies memorization, outliers or mislabels rather than beneficial data to repeat.
limitations: TracIn estimates target-specific attribution along a realized trajectory; it is not a prospective replay utility guarantee.
The practical checkpoint approximation depends on human choices of checkpoints, layers, loss heads and projections.
The main quantitative task is mislabeled-data recovery and lacks a strict same-budget random replay intervention.
No cross-seed stability analysis, FN95 endpoint or equal cumulative replay exposure is reported.
stage1_mechanism_zh: TracIn 对 Stage1 最重要的启示是 A 必须沿训练路径记录，而不是仅在终点计算一次：在 120/140/150/160 等 checkpoint 上，可对固定候选和独立 FN95-critical probe 计算最后一层梯度点积、符号及跨阶段一致性，并把高 self-influence 当作 Q 风险信号而非奖励。
stage1_non_inference_zh: 高 TracIn、自影响或多 checkpoint 正点积都不能直接定义高价值样本。论文主要验证归因和错标识别，没有增加样本曝光；checkpoint 近似忽略真实访问顺序，且错误分类样本会因大梯度占据榜首。Stage1 必须用固定曝光 T/R1/R2/current-loss/no-replay 干预验证任何 TracIn-inspired 规则。
